name: fogport-letters
description: 《雾港来信》——由 Qwen 驱动的中文文字冒险游戏

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.build:hosted: npm run typecheck && npm run build:hosted --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace shared && npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
